QuestInfo.name: Finding the Instructor
QuestInfo.0: It seems like #b#p411##k in #b#m10003000##k wants to test whether I'm worthy of receiving his teachings.
QuestInfo.1: #m10003000#'s #b#p411# gave me a letter to deliver to the #b#p424##k, who I should be able to find somewhere at the #b#m10003080##k. He said I'd learn the rest of the details there.
QuestInfo.2: At #b#m10003080##k, I met #b#p424##k. He said he would test whether I was worthy of making the 2nd job advancement. Great! I told him I was ready for anything!

0.0: Well, what do you think? Don't you want to get even more powerful? Pass a simple test and I'll help you do just that. Do you want to do it?

yes.0: Good thinking. But I need to make sure you are as strong as you look. It's not a hard test, one that should be easy for you to pass. First, take this letter... Make sure you don't lose it.
yes.1: Please get this letter to the #b#p424##k around #b#m10003080##k near #m10003000#. He's taking on the job of instructor in my place.
yes.2: Give him the letter and he'll give you the test for me. If you want more details, hear it straight from him. I wish you good luck.

no.0: Really...? It would help you a great deal on your journey if you get stronger quickly. See me if you ever change your mind. I'll make you much more powerful than you are right now.

1.0: Hmmm... It definitely is the letter from #b#p411##k... So, you came all the way here to take the test and make the 2nd job advancement as a Thief?
